title: Tailwise Autoship Claim Windows and Remedies, Program by Program
content:
Tailwise Autoship claims on a charged shipment are taken within program-specific windows, and the remedy settings differ by program. The claims desk works from the following table.

| | Everyday | Litter & Bulk | Fresh & Frozen | Custom Meal Plan | Pharmacy | Compounded Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Damaged or wrong-item claim window (calendar days after the ship date) | 30 | 30 | 7 | 7 | 14 | 7 |
| Missing-shipment claim window (calendar days after the ship date) | 21 | 21 | 5 | 5 | 14 | 5 |
| Free replacement may be sent instead of a refund | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Where an accepted claim is refunded | Original payment method | Original payment method | Original payment method | Tailwise credit | Original payment method | Original payment method |
| Shipping fee refunded when every unit of the shipment is claimed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Satisfaction guarantee on food and treats, opened or not | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Quality claim window (calendar days after the ship date) | 90 | 90 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Unopened return window (calendar days after the ship date) | 365 | 365 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes

- A window of 0 means the claim type does not apply: Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy take no quality claims, and only Autoship Everyday and Autoship Litter & Bulk take unopened returns.
- The satisfaction guarantee line states whether food and treats from the program may be refunded as a quality claim even when opened.
- Autoship Custom Meal Plan is the only program whose accepted claims are refunded as Tailwise credit.
- Autoship Compounded Pharmacy is the only program that does not refund the shipping fee on a claim covering every unit.

## Reading the table

| Question | Answer from the table |
|---|---|
| Damaged-claim window, Autoship Fresh & Frozen against Autoship Everyday | 7 days against 30 days |
| Missing-shipment window, Autoship Pharmacy | 14 days |
| Replacement available on Autoship Custom Meal Plan | No |
